title: MMLA-RSI: Recursive Self-Improvement through RTT and RTMA
abstract: arXiv:2610.20294v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: An agent can improve its behavior within an unresolved problem by changing how it acts and which experience it retains. We propose MMLA-RSI, a recursive self-improvement scheme with two implementations in Memory-Mediated Learning Architecture: Reasoning-Time Training (RTT) changes the policy state $\Phi$, while Reasoning-Time Memory Adaptation (RTMA) changes authoritative memory $M$. Each route also makes its adaptation method an object of improvement. A current numerical updater trains the policy proposing its successor; a current memory manager chooses the records available to the process proposing its successor. An independently admitted successor takes over the same role in the next generation. We give bounded executable rule languages, shared task/proposal interfaces, and one algorithm for either route or their composition. translated_title: MMLA-RSI：通过RTT和RTMA实现的递归自我改进
translated_abstract: 智能体可以通过改变其行为方式和所保留的经验，在未解决的问题中改进自身的行为。我们提出MMLA-RSI，这是一种在记忆中介学习架构中具有两种实现的递归自我改进方案：推理时训练（RTT）改变策略状态 $\Phi$，而推理时记忆适配（RTMA）改变权威记忆 $M$。每条路线还将其适配方法本身作为改进的对象。当前的数值更新器训练提出其后继者的策略；当前的记忆管理器选择可供提出其后继者的进程所使用的记录。被独立接纳的后继者在下一代中接管相同的角色。我们给出了有界可执行规则语言、共享的任务/提案接口，以及适用于任一路线或其组合的单一算法。RTT实例在有界动量更新中改变标量调度；RTMA实例选择NULL或一个co（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出了一种递归自我改进方案MMLA-RSI，其中RTT改变策略状态、RTMA改变权威记忆，且这两种改进方法本身也可作为改进对象，由独立接纳的后继者在下一代中接管相同角色，从而实现智能体行为的持续递归改进。
en_tdlr: MMLA-RSI is a recursive self-improvement scheme in which RTT updates the policy state and RTMA adapts authoritative memory, with each adaptation method itself serving as an object of improvement taken over by independently admitted successors in the next generation.
